interpretation: Bluetooth remains responsive while the console sleeps. Frequent 51 status polling does not reset/prevent this W1 sleep state. The 343.3s observation-to-sleep interval is not a measured inactivity timeout from physical stop or last button input.
next_candidate: Official FitShow v1.1 protocol describes 53/01 mode high bit 0x80 as READY without start, expected status 9. Unverified on W1; it remains motor-capable and must be tested under a separate bounded motor trial, never a nonmotor query. No keepalive fix claimed.
